name: Template
title: Template
subtitle: One row per customer state: what the state allows a recipe to ask and show

rows.User state: Doesn't know they have a problem. Not looking for you. Distracted. Skeptical of ads.
rows.Channel: Where they already are (feeds, search, podcasts, press, communities)
rows.Surface: Feed, For You, SERP, podcast player, community thread
rows.Metric: Reach, VTR, follower growth, branded search lift
rows.Why this and not that: Rules out forms, gated content, demos, trials; long-form, dense, technical content; email (no address yet); in-app surfaces; pricing pages, case studies, ROI calculators
rows.B2C state: Scrolling. Not looking. Doesn't know you.
rows.B2B secondary recipe: Original research and expert point of view (B-AW)
rows.Source: Combining file (awareness constraints, forced values, rule-outs); B2C playbook (state)

rows.User state: Just starting to feel the problem; searching “how to fix X.”
rows.Format: Blog, guide, listicle, how-to video, tip posts
rows.Surface: SERP, article, feed, thread, podcast player
rows.Metric: Organic traffic, saves, shares, time on page
rows.Why this and not that: Rules out forms, gated content, demos, trials; email (no list); pricing and proof content
rows.B2C state: Feels the pain. Searching “how to fix X.”
rows.B2B secondary recipe: Original research and expert point of view (B-AW)
rows.Source: Combining file (awareness constraints, forced values, rule-outs); B2C playbook (state)

rows.User state: Knows solutions exist. Comparing approaches. “Best X for Y.”
rows.Format: Comparison, review roundup, quiz, honest review
rows.Channel: SEO, YouTube, review sites, communities, website
rows.Surface: Comparison page, review profile, quiz page, video, thread
rows.Metric: MQL equivalent, email captures, add-to-cart, saves
rows.Why this and not that: Rules out hard sell and contracts; vendor-only claims without third-party proof
rows.Source: Derived: stage file (state, CTA, metric) + B2C playbook (recipes); constraint values not stated in sources

rows.User state: Knows you. Checking you out. “Is this legit? Worth it?”

rows.Metric: Conversion rate, add-to-cart, review volume, branded search

rows.Source: Derived: stage file (state, CTA, metric) + B2C playbook (recipes); constraint values not stated in sources
